theme: deadline budget PARSEMS + HUMANMS + FROMTIME ISO remain gate

weaknesses.title: HUMANMS multi-unit labels are not PARSEMS-round-trippable
weaknesses.detail: HUMANMS 1250 → 1s250ms; PARSEMS fails trailing junk. HUMANMS 90000 → 1m30s also fails. Only pure single-unit labels reparse. Agents that store human labels lose budgets.
weaknesses.repro: HUMANMS 1250; PARSEMS LAST → OK=0 trailing junk

weaknesses.title: Remain math forced to whole-second TIME — sub-second budgets imprecise
weaknesses.detail: No MS-based wall clock for deadlines. budget_ms/1000 floor drops sub-second. Agents needing 500ms budgets get 0s deadline delta.

weaknesses.title: FROMTIME is UTC only — no local ISO dual
weaknesses.detail: LOCAL exists separately; agents wanting local deadline stamps must hand-format. No FROMTIME LOCAL flag.

weaknesses.title: No compound input parse (1h30m) despite HUMANMS compound output
weaknesses.detail: Asymmetry: format multi-unit, parse single-unit only. Config authors write 1h30m and get soft fail.

weaknesses.title: HAS on duration labels unit false friends
weaknesses.detail: HAS 5s s → 1; HAS 1m30s m → 1. Cannot classify unit with HAS.

weaknesses.title: No DEADLINE/REMAIN one-shot helpers
weaknesses.detail: Agents hand TIME + budget/1000 + FROMTIME. Race window and unit bugs common.

workarounds: Store budget as integer ms not human label
Use whole-second budgets for TIME-based deadlines
Prefer UTC ISO stamps; LOCAL only for display
language_gaps: Wall deadline helpers using MS not only TIME seconds
issues_faced: multi-unit HUMANMS→PARSEMS fail is core lesson
